closed.title: Candidate readiness owner and cache boundary
closed.detail: ModelReadinessRegistry is keyed by provider selection identity. ProviderFactory can create a candidate independently, while only AgentRuntimeAdapter._installProvider mutates service.provider, service.agent.provider and providerSelection. The readiness algorithm can therefore probe a candidate object without changing active authority.

The regression proves candidate B can pass or fail readiness while active provider A remains service.provider, service.agent.provider and providerSelection; candidate readiness is cached under B. Production Cline Test READY now uses discoverOnly:true + probeReadiness:true, while Use remains the explicit activation path.
